patches.summary: Added pp:data-source annotations to all 5 novel feature files.
patches.reason: Dogfood framework requires pp:data-source (local/live/computed) annotations for novel feature classification.

patches.summary: Security hardening: path traversal guard, file permissions (0o750/0o600), explicit error discards.
patches.reason: gosec scan found G304 path traversal, G301/G306 file permissions, and G104 unhandled errors in hand-authored novel feature files.

patches.summary: Bumped go.mod from go 1.26.3 to go 1.26.4 to fix two stdlib CVEs.
patches.reason: govulncheck reported GO-2026-5039 (net/textproto) and GO-2026-5037 (crypto/x509), fixed in Go 1.26.4.

patches.summary: Restored SKILL.md canonical install section with correct Go version and PATH guidance.
patches.reason: verify-skill reported SKILL.md Prerequisites section had drifted from canonical generator format.

patches.summary: Removed dryRunOK early exit from keywords auto-promote; command has its own dry-run logic.
patches.reason: Live dogfood json_fidelity failure: --dry-run --json produced empty output because dryRunOK() returned nil before the command's own dry-run path could produce JSON.
patches.validated_outcome: keywords auto-promote --campaign-id 12345 --dry-run --json now returns valid JSON

patches.summary: Fixed Example strings in search-resource list-apps and list-geo to use hyphen not underscore.
patches.reason: Generated examples used search_resource (underscore) which does not match the actual command name search-resource (hyphen); caused dogfood happy_path missing-runnable-example failure.
patches.validated_outcome: Live dogfood happy_path tests for search-resource list-apps and list-geo now pass

patches.summary: optimize suggest --apply must accept a --currency flag; non-USD accounts fail when bidAmount.currency is hardcoded to USD.
patches.reason: ASA API rejects bid updates where the currency does not match the org's billing currency; hardcoding USD breaks all non-USD accounts (EUR, GBP, AUD, etc.).

patches.summary: templates apply and optimize suggest must be mcp:read-only false; both issue POST/PUT calls when not in --diff/read-only mode.
patches.reason: MCP agents use mcp:read-only to decide whether a tool mutates state; incorrect true annotation causes agents to invoke write-path commands in read-only contexts.

patches.summary: optimize suggest ROAS path must include expected_cpa_delta in output; delta was computed but never assigned to the suggestion struct.
patches.reason: For roas metric, delta (suggested_bid minus current_bid) was computed in buildBidSuggestions but the ExpectedDelta field was only set for cpa, leaving it zero in all ROAS suggestions.

patches.summary: analytics query --group-by keyword_text and match_type must error, not silently proxy to campaign_name grouping.
patches.reason: The local SQLite cache only holds campaign-level data; proxying keyword_text/match_type to campaign_name produces misleading output with no indication the grouping changed.
